title: Tax Preparation Software Cost Guide for 2026
description: A cost comparison of tax preparation software for individuals, freelancers, and small businesses, covering TurboTax, H&R Block, TaxSlayer, FreeTaxUSA, and Drake Software.
body:
Tax preparation software pricing ranges from free federal filing options to several hundred dollars for comprehensive business and investment tax preparation. Understanding the pricing structure and feature availability at each tier is essential for selecting the right platform.

This guide examines the pricing models of five major tax preparation platforms. None have published pricing verification data at the time of writing, so check each vendor's current pricing page for exact rates, as pricing varies by edition and filing complexity.

## TurboTax

TurboTax is the most widely used tax preparation software, known for its guided interview process and comprehensive deduction discovery. Its pricing is structured around filing complexity, with costs increasing as tax situations become more complicated.

TurboTax offers free federal filing for simple returns. Paid tiers for homeowners, investors, and self-employed filers add deduction discovery, investment loss tracking, and business expense categorization. State filing carries an additional fee at each tier.

The audit risk assessment and maximum refund guarantee are included at higher tiers. TurboTax's pricing reflects its brand premium and the depth of its deduction guidance.

Check TurboTax's current pricing page for exact rates for each edition, as Intuit adjusts pricing annually.

## H&R Block

H&R Block competes directly with TurboTax with a similar tiered pricing structure. Its software provides comparable deduction guidance and filing support, often at slightly lower price points for equivalent tiers.

H&R Block's free edition supports simple returns. Paid editions add investment income, rental property, and self-employment filing. The platform includes free audit support on all paid editions and offers in-person filing assistance through local offices.

H&R Block's pricing advantage is typically a small discount compared to TurboTax for equivalent filing complexity. The platform also provides price matching guarantees.

Check H&R Block's current pricing page for exact rates.

## TaxSlayer

TaxSlayer serves self-preparers who have tax knowledge and want affordable software. Its pricing is lower than the major brands, with fewer guided interview prompts and more direct form-based navigation.

TaxSlayer's Simply Free edition covers basic returns. The Classic tier adds state filing and customer support. The Premium tier adds priority phone support and audit assistance. Self-employed and business filing capabilities are available at the Premium tier.

TaxSlayer is best suited for tax-confident filers who do not need the handholding of TurboTax or H&R Block. The cost savings can be meaningful for filers with relatively simple to moderately complex returns.

Check TaxSlayer's current pricing page for exact rates.

## FreeTaxUSA

FreeTaxUSA offers free federal filing for all return types, including self-employment and business income. State filing carries a modest fee. Its pricing model is the simplest among major tax software providers.

FreeTaxUSA supports all major IRS forms and schedules, including Schedule C for self-employment, Schedule D for capital gains, and forms for rental income and small business expenses. The platform provides deduction guidance but with less depth than TurboTax.

FreeTaxUSA is appropriate for cost-conscious filers with straightforward to moderately complex returns. The free federal filing for all return types makes it particularly attractive for self-employed filers.

Check FreeTaxUSA's current pricing page for exact rates.

## Drake Software

Drake Software serves professional tax preparers rather than individual filers. Its pricing reflects professional-grade features including batch processing, client management, and multi-state filing capabilities.

Drake's pricing includes per-return pricing for low-volume preparers and unlimited packages for high-volume firms. Professional features include e-filing, bank product integration, and practice management tools.

Drake Software is appropriate for tax preparation businesses, not individual filers. Its pricing and feature set reflect professional-grade requirements.

Check Drake Software's current pricing page for exact rates.

## Selection Guidance

The right tax preparation software depends on filing complexity, confidence, and budget. Simple filers can use TurboTax or H&R Block free editions or FreeTaxUSA for truly free federal filing. Homeowners and investors should compare TurboTax Deluxe and H&R Block Premium. Self-employed filers benefit from FreeTaxUSA for cost savings or TurboTax Self-Employed for maximum deduction guidance. Professional preparers need Drake Software's professional-grade features.
